verdicts.rationale: CONFIRMED: Qdrant PUT /collections/{c}/points exhibits validation inconsistency between sync(wait=true) and async(wait=false) modes. When inserting 3D vector into 4D collection: sync correctly returns 400 'Vector dimension error', but async returns 200 acknowledged without actually storing the point. Source code confirms dimension validation only occurs in sync path (lib/segment/src/common/operation_error.rs defines WrongVectorDimension error, but it's only thrown when wait=true). This is a Type1_IllegalSuccess: async path accepts invalid input (returns 200) instead of rejecting with 4xx, violating API contract consistency. Not by-design: developers prioritize 'Data consistency and persistence over API strictness', making this a real bug requiring fix.
